title: Best Robotic Arm (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were chosen from the products explicitly named in the supplied sources (PCMag, CNET, Dobot‑Robots). Preference was given to items mentioned by more than one source.
assumptions: No price information was used except where a source gave a figure; all other pricing is omitted.

verdict.line: Buy it if you want a robot vacuum that can also pick up small items. It offers the only mechanical arm in a consumer vacuum, but the arm still struggles with object handling and software bugs.
